svg.title: Two integrations introduce two independent constants
svg.desc: Starting from second derivative two gives first derivative two x plus A, then function x squared plus A x plus B. Integrating the first constant gives the term A x; B is a new additional constant. The slope condition f prime of one equals one gives A negative one. The point condition f of one equals four then gives B four. The final function x squared minus x plus four satisfies both conditions and has second derivative two.
